description: Launch readiness check for a site built with this toolkit: runs the site's own build and tests first, then checks only what they cannot (legal pages, E-E-A-T and local signals, content the site's settings call for, testimonial consent, what only a deployed site shows), asks only where the owner's intent decides, and writes a dated report with a verdict to docs/launch/ as Markdown plus a self-contained HTML page. When the site replaces an older one, also a current-vs-new comparison with a redirect map for every old address. Runs three times in new-website (baseline after the scaffold, the verdict before launch, an optional live re-check) and on its own. Trigger phrases: "launch check", "ready to launch", "what's missing before launch", "pre-launch", "go live", "launch audit", "relaunch", "compare the old and the new site", "post-launch gap analysis".
